name: dump-truck
description: A dump truck with a raised rear-tipping bed.
useCase: Choose a dump truck for construction vehicles or hauling services.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The front of the bed rises beside the cab while the rear end stays lower. At least 1px separates the bed from the chassis, cab and rear wheel.

24.reason: The raised front end and lower rear end show a rear-tipping bed. More than 1.5px separates the bed from the cab, chassis and wheels.
